Initial release of MCP Engineering skill – a comprehensive guide to building, integrating, and securing Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and clients.

- Covers MCP fundamentals, architecture, and core concepts.
- Provides step-by-step instructions and code templates for server implementation in TypeScript and Python.
- Outlines key tool design principles and best practices.
- Includes guidance on transport decisions (stdio vs HTTP), authentication (API key, OAuth), and production readiness.
- Features client integration and practical checklists for robust, scalable MCP deployments.
